root.title: Canonical productive planning cutover
root.objective: Integrate daemon planning composition, the canonical PlanningEngine, deterministic verification, direct compilation, legacy retirement and regression gates without changing lifecycle ownership or repository identity.
concerns: Keep SemanticPlan as the only planning output.
Keep planning ownership in the daemon.
Make the legacy WorkBreakdown route unreachable.
Preserve prior lifecycle and repository gates.

outcomes.description: The daemon composes the canonical planner, verifier and direct compiler as the only productive planning route.
RecursivePlanner, WorkBreakdown projection and legacy graph compilation are unreachable from productive planning entrypoints.
Daemon lifecycle ownership, exact repository grounding and existing gates remain protected after cutover.

cut.rationale: The goal crosses the daemon application boundary, canonical contracts, planner, verifier and compiler, while each writable path has one cohesive leaf owner and the parent owns final integration.

children.title: Daemon planning composition
children.objective: Compose canonical productive planning at the daemon-owned entrypoint while preserving repository grounding and lifecycle event ownership.
concerns: Remove the RecursivePlanner and legacy projection route from the productive composition.
Keep exact RepositoryView identity and daemon-owned event publication.

outcomes.description: The daemon invokes canonical planning, deterministic verification and direct compilation through its existing lifecycle boundary.

children.title: Canonical PlanningEngine route
children.objective: Produce the sole canonical SemanticPlan with typed planning outcomes and no parallel plan representation.

outcomes.description: The canonical planning engine produces SemanticPlan material for verification and direct compilation.

children.title: Deterministic verifier authority
children.objective: Verify exact SemanticPlan material deterministically before compilation and return typed attributable findings.
concerns: Bind findings to the exact candidate identity.
Do not duplicate planning or graph representations.

outcomes.description: Deterministic authority validates canonical SemanticPlan material before the compiler accepts it.

children.title: Direct SemanticPlan compiler
children.objective: Transform verified SemanticPlan material directly into one canonical GraphRevision without legacy projection.
concerns: Eliminate WorkBreakdown projection from the productive path.
Preserve explicit artifacts, seams and resource ownership.

outcomes.description: The direct compiler consumes SemanticPlan and emits GraphRevision without an intermediate WorkBreakdown.

children.title: Legacy WorkBreakdown unreachable
children.objective: Cut productive adapter reachability to RecursivePlanner, WorkBreakdown projection and legacy graph compilation while preserving the daemon effect boundary.
concerns: Prove reachability removal statically with a negative control.

outcomes.description: Productive planning entrypoints cannot reach the legacy planning and graph-projection route.

children.title: Regression gates and canonical graph
children.objective: Preserve daemon lifecycle ownership, exact repository grounding and canonical GraphRevision invariants on the combined candidate.
concerns: Exercise prior gates on the exact integrated candidate.

outcomes.description: Lifecycle, repository grounding and canonical graph regression gates remain applicable to the cutover candidate.

seams.purpose: Carry the exact grounded daemon planning request into the canonical PlanningEngine.

interface.promise: The daemon supplies goal, acceptance criteria, constraints and exact repository identity; the planner returns a typed canonical planning outcome.

seams.purpose: Pass canonical SemanticPlan material to deterministic verification.

interface.promise: The verifier receives the exact canonical SemanticPlan identity produced by the PlanningEngine.

seams.purpose: Expose SemanticPlan as the direct compiler input without WorkBreakdown projection.

interface.promise: The compiler consumes canonical SemanticPlan directly and does not accept a productive parallel planning representation.

seams.purpose: Authorize compilation only for the exact SemanticPlan candidate accepted by deterministic verification.

interface.promise: Verification identity matches the SemanticPlan compiled into GraphRevision and required findings block compilation.
